criteria: Correct counts and means for all groups and maximum group
No unnecessary graph reload or query repeat after presentation failure
Scoped interpretation: proposed memory is not authority or handle validity
Observed skill read, retrieval/read/feedback receipts when relevant
controls: Same prompt except arm and memory policy
Same inherited model/settings requested; actual model telemetry may be unavailable
Separate worker contexts; shared filesystem isolated by instructions, not OS enforcement
No source-code/fixture-formula shortcut as sole answer evidence
Control cannot read wiki, retrieval results, other arm or evaluator material
limitations: One pair, synthetic data, known failure chosen to match one candidate
Both workers share base skill guidance about bounded display and result completeness
Tool response capture by workers must be audited; unobserved calls remain uncertain
Not a blinded population estimate or causal model-quality proof
